bullets.text: Under supervision in an individual project, wrote Python functions to parse provided research abstract records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.
Under supervision, compared TF-IDF and pretrained sentence-embedding retrieval on held-out judged queries, examined recall at fixed cutoffs, and grouped retrieval errors by query type.
Under supervision, joined document identifiers to bibliographic metadata using SQL, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons, and documented missing-data handling.

As an individual contribution to a supervised course team project, implemented reusable Python modules for the document metadata workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.

Within the supervised team project, validated SQL joins for company report metadata with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and visualized how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.

Within supervised team research, compared TF-IDF and pretrained sentence-embedding retrieval on held-out judged queries, examined recall at fixed cutoffs, and grouped retrieval errors by query type.
